limitation: County-wide context, not fire-caused outages or household service status. Only positive reports are supplied; absence may mean zero or a collection gap. No missing row is filled. Current Census county geometry links the fire to counties, not a historical outage footprint. Daily maxima are maxima of available positive reports, not unique affected customers or complete-day peaks.
sourceMissingness: Blank source counts are retained as unknown records, separate from numeric series. No zero is substituted.

rejected.reason: Invalid source perimeter; no automatic repair

policy.reason: User extended the verified MTBS boundary fallback to smoke, NOAA and recovery checks. Use only an already-linked MTBS boundary when the preferred boundary is invalid, record both sources, and never replace a reviewed boundary result.

scope.spatialRelationship: County-wide context in counties intersecting the fire; not outages inside the perimeter or attributed to the fire.
